tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma'i bum pa'i cho ga nyams grib mthar byed bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ nyam thag 'gro la rab brtse bas// skyon bral khro mo'i skur bstan nas// mi gtsang dri ma kun sel ma// mkha' 'gro sme brtsegs la btud nas// snyigs dus gdug can dar ba'i dus// 'gro kun bag med kyis gos pa'i// nyams grib mi gtsang sbyong ba'i phyir// sme ba brtsegs ma'i khrus chog 'bri// 'dir gru spang rtse ba rdo rje seng ge la mkha' 'gro ma seng ge gdong can gyis gnang ba'i khro mo sme brtsegs kyi khrus chog la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni stegs bu gtsang mar pad+ma 'dab brgyad rdul tshon nam ras dkar la bris pa'i steng du bum pa mgul chings dang bcas pa'i nang du bum snying nyer lnga chu gtsang dang bcas pa kha rgyan can gyi steng du/ dung chos dri bzang gis gang ba gzungs rdor dang bcas pa'i mthar/ mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang*/ bum pa'i mdun du zlum gtor gcig gzhan yang rdo rje dril bu me tog sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog sogs nas/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ zhes pa nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon tu 'gro bas/ sems bskyed kyi tshig spyi 'gre la/ mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes dang*/

tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma sku mdog sol ba ltar nag pa/ skyon cis kyang 'gor mi btub pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol bas dag byed kyi bum pa chus bkang ba bsnams pa/ nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad 'khrud par mdzad pa/ gcer bu rgyan spangs shing pad nyi'i gdan la zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i sku can du gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ khar+khaṃ dzi r+khaṃ bi ma la se u tsuṣ+ma kro dhī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas te/ mi gtsang ba nyes pa gang gis kyang mi gos par bsam mo// gal te mdze pho dang*/ yugs sa dang*/ mi gdong so ma dang*/ dam nyams dang*/ tshul khrims 'chal ba dang*/ dme can dang*/ 'khon can la sogs pa dang 'grogs dgos pa byung na skad cig las lhar bsams te bzlas brjod shub bur bya ba'am/ ma grub na'ang khro mo'i bskyed rim gyi nga rgyal brtan par byas pas nyes pas mi gos pa ni myong bas grub pa yin no// bzlas pa'i mthar 'og gtor 'bul gyi rjes nas 'byung ba'i 'dod gsol de bya/ gsum pa ni bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma nas/ sku can du gyur bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ 'di la gnas gsum byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren stim dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams ma bshad pas/ dam ye dbyer med du bskyed pa la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ u tsuṣ+ma kro dhī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i mthar dharmā ra ṇi ta dril gsil rol chen/

bstod pa ni/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// mi gtsang dri ma kun sel zhing*// gtsang dag bde la 'god mdzad pa'i// mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo la phyag 'tshal// sol ba ltar nag 'gyur med sku// nyes skyon kun gyis mi tshugs shing*// gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// mi gtsang kun sel la phyag 'tshal// ro gcig zhal dang dus gsum spyan// thabs shes phyag dang gzung 'dzin gyi// rnam rtog gnon pa'i zhabs gnyis ma// rtag chad mkha' gnon la phyag 'tshal// dri med rin chen las grub cing*// dag byed bdud rtsis yongs gang ba'i// bum gnyis phyag mtshan thugs kar bsnol// bden gnyis zung 'jug la phyag 'tshal// de las byung ba'i bdud rtsi yis// skal ldan 'gro ba'i sgo gsum sdig /nyams grib mi gtsang kun 'khrud pa'i// khrus kyi lha mo la phyag 'tshal// rtog pa kun las nges grol bas// gos rgyan spangs pa gcer mo'i sku// bdag med rtogs pas dbu skra bsil// rnam par dag ma la phyag 'tshal// 'khor ba'i skyon bral pad+ma'i steng*// thugs rje'i 'od gsal nyi ma'i gdan// dgos 'dod kun gyi rang bzhin la// mnyam bzhengs mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal// gang gi mthu chen rig sngags ni// bzlas brjod nyung ngu bgyis pas kyang*// mi gtsang dri ma kun sel zhing*// yang dag bde stsol la phyag 'tshal// mtha' bral chos dbyings ye shes thugs// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gis// nyam thag 'gro la rab brtse ma// bde stong zung 'jug la phyag 'tshal// de sogs dus gsum rgyal ba yi// yon tan phrin las kun gyi bdag /mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo sme brtsegs la// bstod pa'i dge des don kun stsol// snyigs dus gnas grogs yo byad sogs// mi gtsang kho na shas che bas// sa lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen grib// de kun nye bar zhi bar mdzod// khyad par bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rdo rje theg pa'i bslab pa dang*// 'gal ba'i nyes kun byang bar mdzod// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs 'gal dang*// dam tshig nyams pa'i slob ma dang*// spyod yul gcig dang gsang sgrog sogs// ltung ba 'byung kun dag par mdzod// bskyed rdzogs g.yel zhing bzlas pa nyung*// lta ba ma bskyangs spyod pa rtsing*// mi shes ma gus bag med kyis// nyes pa ci mchis zhi bar mdzod// mthu ldan chos skyong srung kun la// sgom sgrub mchod gtor chags pa dang*// 'bags btsog thugs 'gal bgyis pa sogs// nongs pa ci mchis sel bar mdzod// mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs la// ma dad ma gus bgyis pa dang*// log par bltas pa'i las sgrib kun// khyed kyi thugs rjes byang bar mdzod// mdor na bla ma dkon mchog nas// sems can phra mo yan chad la// brten pa'i las sgrib ci bsags pa// de kun byang zhing dag par mdzod// de ltar sdig sgrib nyer dag nas// 'di dang skye ba thams cad du// dal 'byor lus thob dbang po gsal// nad med tshe ring dpal 'byor mdzod// yang dag bla mas rjes bzung nas// rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal ba dang*// mdo sngags rig gnas shes bya'i tshogs// yon tan kun la bdag mkhas mdzod// bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin zab mo yi// yang dag ye shes skye ba dang*// las bzhi'i phrin las gang bsam kun// 'gro don thogs med 'byung bar mdzod// bdag ni mthong thos dran pa dang*// reg pa tsam gyis 'gro ba kun// nyams sgrib sdig pa kun sel ba// mkha' 'gro dbang mo khyod ltar mdzod// mdor na bdag gis bstan 'gro la// lhag bsam rnam dag bgyis pa kun// bar chad med par mthar phyir nas// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun 'grub shog

/gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags sbyar ba'i mchod pa gong bzhin dang*/ bstod pa gang gi mtshan tsam ma sh+lo ka gcig bcom ldan 'das ma khro bo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad zhi ba dang*/ myur du khro bo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs ma'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gzungs thag bzung ste rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la zhon te song ba bum nang gi lha la phog pas de'i sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes dang bdag bskyed du bshad pa'i sngags de dang*/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ baṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e baṃ raṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ a a a swā hā/ zhes sngags gnyis po 'di brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus bzlas la mchod bstod 'dod gsol gong ltar dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum bya/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsir gyur/ zhes brjod cing gzungs thag bsdu'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sme ba brtsegs ma 'grub gyur nas sogs bsngo smon ci shes dang*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs kyis bkra shis bya'o// byabs khrus byed na lha sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs rnam 'joms bzhin no// 'di'i rjes gnang bya tshul gyi bsham/ tshom bu gcig zlum gtor/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod spyi dang 'dra/

mchod pa byin rlabs sngon 'gro'i bdag bskyed gong bzhin/ tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ skad cig gis lha mo bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams gong bzhin dang bzlas pa bya/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs sogs spyi dang 'gre/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ bsdu na/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la sogs/ gzhi dgod pa dang ye shes pa spyan drang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang la thugs ka'i nyi dkyil sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad nas slob ma'i khar zhugs pa sogs bya/ dam bca'/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung mdzad/ gzhan spyi 'gre/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ ḍā ki ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ gru spang rtse ba rdo rje seng ge chos rje brag nag pa/ byang sems chen po/ bla ma dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dar/ bde phug pa bde legs rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ dpal gnas gsar ba chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la stsal ba'o// yang na mkhyen brtse/ byams pa skal bzang*/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra'o// ces mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma'i chos skor bum chog sogs nyer mkho cha tshang 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'di'i sgrub thabs gnas gsar ba 'jam mgon mkhyen brtses mdzad pa dang jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i sme brtsegs ljang nag gi bum mchog thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa gnyis gung bsgrigs/

rjes gnang mdzad byang med pa 'di thog nas phyag len la gnang srol yod pa de yang rjes sbrel la mthud/ bstod pa 'dod gsol bcas dang mtshams sbyor ci dgos nged rang nas gsar brtsams bgyis te 'gro phan kho na'i bsam pas sbyar ba 'di'i dge bas sems can thams cad nyams grib mi gtsang ba'i 'dam las thar nas yang dag pa'i dpal la spyod par gyur cig/ ༈ /mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma'i sgrub thabs phrin las kyi cho ga dang bcas pa snying por dril ba bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'dir gru spang rtse pa rdo rje seng ge la/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can gyis gnang ba'i khro mo sme brtsegs kyi sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma sku mdog sol ba ltar nag pa/ skyon cis kyang 'gos su mi btub pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba'i phyag rgyas dag byed kyi bum pa chus bkang ba bsnams pa/ nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad 'khrud par mdzad pa/ gcer bu rgyan spangs shing pad nyi'i gdan la zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i sku can du gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ khar+khaṃ dzir+khaṃ bi ma la se u tsuṣ+ma kro dhī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das ma khro mo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad zhi ba dang*/ myur du khro mo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs ma'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ mi gtsang ba'i nyes pa gang gis kyang mi gos pa'i nges shes brtan po bya/ gal te mdze pho dang*/ yugs sa dang*/ mi gdong so ma dang*/ dam nyams dang*/ tshul khrims 'chal ba dang*/

dme can dang*/ 'khon can la sogs pa dang 'grogs dgos pa byung na/ skad cig gis lhar bsams la bzlas brjod shub bur bya ba'am/ ma grub na'ang khro mo'i bskyed rim gyi nga rgyal brtan par byas pas/ nyes pas mi gos pa ni myong bas grub pa yin no// bum chog byed na/ stegs kyi khar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings dung chos gzungs rdor dang bcas pa'i mdun du zlum gtor dkar po dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas bsham/ mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swā bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thog pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa 'dod gsol yan gong ltar mthar/ mdun gyi bum pa/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma nas/ sku can du gyur bar bdag bskyed ltar gsal btab la/ oṃ u tsuṣ+ma kro dhī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi tas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// mi mthun dri ma kun sel zhing*// gtsang dag bde la 'god mdzad pa// mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/

gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ sngags kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma khro mo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs mas sogs/ bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi 'dod gsol sbyar/ gzungs thag la bzung ste/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la zhon te bum pa'i nang du song*/ bum nang gi thugs kar phog de'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la/ bzlas pa ci nus dang*/ mthar/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ baṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e baṃ raṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ a a a swā hā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzlas mchod bstod 'dod gsol gong ltar dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsir gyur/ ces brjod cing gzungs thag bsdu/ khrus chu rang nyid kyis btung ba dang gnas khang la gtor bas nyams grib mi gtsang ba thams cad sel ba'i mchog tu gsungs shing*/ gzhan bkru byabs srung gsum gyis rjes su 'dzin par 'dod na/ bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod par/ sbyong chas rnams phyag len bzhin bshams la gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o khyed rang rnams kyi 'gal rkyen nad gdon grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad zhi zhing bsrung bar bya ba dang*/ mthun rkyen shis pa'i legs tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par bya ba'i slad du khro mo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs ma'i khrus kyi cho ga'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin pa la'ang*/ gdon bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba sogs bya ba dang*/

bgegs zhi ba'i phyir bkru byabs srung gsum dang*/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa dang*/ shis par bya ba rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar gdon bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ las kyi rdo rjes bsgrub bya la gtor ma g.yas phyogs su bskor zhing*/ rang gi lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na ma sarba ta thā ga ta zhes sogs brjod de se gol gyi sgra bya/ de lta bu lan gsum byas la zhi bas sbyang bzhin du ting lo dang changs bu bskor ba dang bstun la rdo rje gsor zhing rtsa sngags dang sum+bha lan gsum gyis mthar/ 'dir rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ changs bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces zhi drag phyed mas sbyang*/ spro na khro bo spyan 'dren gdan 'bul mchod bstod rnams byas pa'i mthar/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma khro mo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs ma'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pa des mgu bar gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes dang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos rtsa sngags dang*/

sum+bha bzla zhing rol mo drag tu bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brabs la gong du khro bo spyan 'dren byas na slar yang*/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing sogs kyi mthar/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes sogs sbyar ba lan gnyis te drag po'i sbyong ba lan gsum bya/ gnyis pa bgegs zhi ba'i phyir bkru byabs srung gsum las/ thog mar bkru ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar thogs te khyed rang rnams la khrus bgyis pa la brten nas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa nad gdon grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad byang zhing dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs kyi mthar/ rtsa sngags dang*/ sarba pā pe bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sarba bigh+nān= sarba ro ge= sarba duṣ+ṭān= sarba gra he= sarba dz+wā re= sarba byā dhi= sarba u pa dra be= sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu= sarba dur+sawap+ni= sarba durni mit+te= sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bkru'o// khar chu cung zad 'dzin du bcug la/ de nas byabs pa'i slad du rma bya'i mdongs kyi thig le'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sgros bskor zhing byabs pa dang*/ sngags phreng las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bkrus pas ma dag pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad lhag ma med par rdo khab len gyis lcags phye len pa ltar tsen gyis blangs te phyir dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rtsa sngags mthar/ sarba pā pe bh+yaḥ.a pa na ye swā hā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang sbyar te byabs la/ kha yi chu phyir 'don/ slar yang bsrung bar bya ba'i slad du/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su slob dpon gyis rdo rjes rig pas/

rdo rje de las de 'dra ba'i rigs can bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste lus la rdo rje'i go khrab bzhu lugs su gyon nas phyin chad nad gdon nyer 'tshe gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa bsrung bar byas pa yin snyam du thugs mos mdzod/ ces slob ma'i spyi bo dang*/ mdun rgyab gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis te gnas bdun du rdo rjes rgya gram du reg la sngags dang*/ sarba pā pe bh+yaḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes sogs sbyar la bsrung*/ gsum pa bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i slad du/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags kyi mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs ma'i nus mthu yis// 'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig /bzhi pa shis par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar khro mo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs ma la/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gsal btab nas/ slob dpon dang lhan cig tu me tog gi char 'bebs shing bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i thugs mos mdzod/ che ba'i che mchog sogs shis brjod ji ltar rigs par bya'o// rjes gnang byed na/ stegs kyi dbus su maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig pa dang*/ zlum gtor/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rnams bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa 'dod gsol yan sngar ltar las/ tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma nas/ sku can du gyur bar bdag bskyed bzhin gsal btab/ mchod bstod gtor 'bul 'dod gsol rnams bum chog bzhin dang*/ mdun bskyed brtan byed kyi bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod par/ me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/

sems bskyed gsal gdab sogs spyi 'gre dang*/ mtshams sbyor gyi khyad par/ 'dir gru spang rtse ba rdo rje seng ge la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis dngos su gnang ba'i khro mo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs ma'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas sogs sbrel la maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs rgyun bshags bya/ gzhi dgod la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi skabs/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las/ sngags phreng gnyis pa chad nas slob ma'i zhal du zhugs par bsam pa tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan dam bca' ba'i lung*/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung rnams sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ltar bya/ dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams byas la slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ mchod bstod/ gsol ba gdab/ lhag chad kha bskang*/ bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo zhing shis pa brjod pa rnams spyi ltar bya'o// rjes gnang dang 'brel bar khrus chog byed na/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod bstod tshar ba'i rjes su/ gong du bshad pa'i bum chog byas la/ rjes gnang gi byin gyis brlab pa'i lung yan chad grub rjes/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi legs par grub nas/ mtha' rten du gdon bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba sogs bya ba dang*/ zhes sogs dkyus ltar shis brjod par bya/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub nas/ gnas skabs de dag tu sogs dkyus ltar ro// yang 'di'i sgo nas grib sel bya bar 'dod na/

srod kyi dus la babs pa'i tshe/ khrus chog dang 'brel bar byed na gong du bshad pa bzhin bum pa dang mchod gtor sogs bsham/ gang ltar yang nye logs ci rigs par/ nad pa'i zan lhag la dri ma bsres shing kha sna'i dbugs kyis bdug par glud lnga bcos te/ lcags dang mkhar ba ma yin pa'i snod du bzhag glud re re la theb kyu dang*/ changs bu gsum re/ ril bu nyer gcig re blugs/ nad pa'i kha gdong bshal ba'i chu thigs nyer gcig gis bran/ skyes pa yin na thu ba g.yas dang*/ bud med yin na thu ba g.yon pa'i dum bus brgyan te bzhag go /de nas slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed dang*/ bum pa bsgrub ba gong bzhin grub rjes/ nad pa'i mdun du gdan nag po'i khar glud rnams dbus dang phyogs bzhir nad pa la kha phyogs te bkod la/ khrus chog dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ 'o/ khyed rang rnams kyi sogs khrus chog ltar la/ sme ba brtsegs ma'i grib sel gyi cho ga zab mo'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin pa la'ang*/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i rim pa la/ thog mar bkru ba'i slad du sogs dkyus ltar/ byabs pa'i slad du sogs nas/ phyir dor ba grib glud rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byabs sngags brjod/ khrus khu glud rnams kyi nang du blugs/ de nas grib sel gyi dngos gzhi grib bdag ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams la glud dang gtor ma sbyin pa'i sgo nas phyir bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la/ glud gtor rnams la chab kyis bran te/ sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thal mo khong stong snying gar sbyar ba chos nyid rnam dag gi rgyas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ rdzas rnams rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ thal mo khong stong sor rtse sprad pa tshigs zur bcag nas smin mtshams su bzhag pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyas/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga zad mi shes pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ thal mo sbyar ba phyir bskyed mthe bong gnyis bsnol te kha'i thad kar 'jog pa bdud rtsi thal sbyor gyi rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yo byad thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ g.yas rdo rje khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng*/ g.yon sa gnon bya ba rgya chen shugs ldan gyis rgyas/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ yo byad thams cad so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par gyur/ g.yas rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bcang g.yon mchog sbyin gyis snod 'degs tshul ye shes skar mda'i rgyas/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ yo byad la mgron rnams 'thab rtsod med par longs spyod par gyur/ lag gnyis sor mo nang du bsnol ba'i mkhrig ma sbyar mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs pa spyi bor 'jog pa dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i rgyas/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañja ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ mgron rnams thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur par bsam zhing sngags rnams lan gsum brjod cing phyag rgya 'grol ba na se gol bya'o// na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas ting nge 'dzin gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma'am/

sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i grib bdag ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas glud gtor len pa'i slad du 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum gyis bkug pas mgron rnams mdun du 'khod par bsams la/ glud gtor bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐/ shar gyi phyogs nas grib sel ma// sku mdog mun ltar nag mo la// dar nag go zu zha la la// chibs su grib rta nag po chibs// rol du grib khyi nag po khrid// klad la grib bya nag po lding*// phyag na grib mdung nag po bsnams// dbu la grib thod nag po bcings// grib len mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// do nub grib 'di len par mdzod// do nub nad 'di len par mdzod// do nub rims 'di len par mdzod// do nub yams 'di len par mdzod// grib bdag chen mo grib longs shig /nad bdag chen mo nad longs shig /rims bdag chen mo rims longs shig /yams bdag chen mo yams longs shig /ces dang*/ lag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ na mas+sa rba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ baṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e baṃ raṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ a a a swā hā/ zhes re re'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas lan bdun gyis bsngos nas/ grib rdzas las grub pa'i glud gtor grib bdag rnams gang 'dod pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa 'dis/ shar phyogs kyi grib bdag ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad tshims nas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa grib kyi gnod pa las grol bar gyur cig ces bden stobs brjod la/ shar gyi glud kha phyir bsgyur/ de bzhin du/ hūm̐/ lho yi phyogs nas grib sel ma// sku mdog mun ltar nag mo la// sogs gong bzhin bden stobs brjod pa'i bar dang*/

des rigs 'gre bas/ hūm̐/ nub kyi phyogs nas sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ byang gi phyogs nas sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ dbus kyi phyogs nas sogs gong bzhin sbyar/ de nas glud thams cad snod gcig tu byas la/ kha phyir bsgyur/ hūm̐/ da ni gshegs so sha ra ra// da ni bzhud do si li li// 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas// rang gi gnas dang rten la gshegs// zhes pas phyogs so sor bskyal ba dang lhan cig rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas/ grib bdag ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad glud gtor rgya chen po byin pa 'dis tshims par gyis la so so rang rang gi gnas su bde bar dengs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sogs dkyus ltar sbyar la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ sum+bha bzla zhing bskrad/ rol mo bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ des grib sel gyi dngos gzhi grub nas/ rjes kyi rim pa la bsrung bar bya ba'i slad du sogs dang*/ de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i slad du sogs dang*/ slar yang shis par bya ba'i slad du sogs sbyar la dkyus ltar bya'o// grib sel rkyang pa byed na/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ glud gtor byin gyis brlab pa nas/ phyir bskrad pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo cis kyang mi chod mi shig par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis brtan par bya zhing*/ shis pa brjod/ bsdu na/ mgron so sor sngags kyis bsngo ba dang bden brjod bzhag nas/ tshigs bcad rnams rkyang pas glud gtor bsngos pa'i mthar/ hūm̐/ da ni gshegs so zhes sogs sbyar bas kyang rung ngo*// 'di ni grub pa'i slob dpon chen po o rgyan pa rin chen dpal la mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mos phul ba'i mkha' 'gro grib sel gyi gdam ngag ces grub mtha' kun la yongs su grags shing*/

bya sla zhing tshegs chung la myong bas grub pa ste/ khro bo sme brtsegs sogs la'ang sbyar du rung zhing*/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu rjes gnang dang 'brel bar byed na/ grib sel gyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar sngon du btang nas/ rjes gnang dkyus bzhin du bya ba phyag len no// gzhan yang las phran tshegs la/ 'phral du grib sel gyi bum sgrub bsdus pa ni/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ bum pa'am snod gtsang mar srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang ma la bum rdzas yod dam med kyang rung ste/ chu yi steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig mthing nag gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ rang gi thugs kar sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi sngags phreng la phog de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas snod gang bar bsams la/ sngags brgya'am nyer gcig bzlas mthar/ sngags phreng gdan dang bcas pa chu la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos nas/ rang gi khong du btang ba dang khrus byas na grib dang mi gtsang bas mi tshugs shing*/ zas gos gnas mal grib can sogs la'ang sngags chu gtor bas thub nges so// gzhan rjes su 'dzin na/ gong gi/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces pa'i mtshams/ des khyed rang rnams la khrus bgyis pa la brten nas nad gdon sdig sgrib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad byang zhing dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la/ rtsa sngags/ las sngags/ spel tshig dang bcas pas bkru zhing shis pa brjod do// sngags mchil gyis grib sel ba ni/ kha zas grib can sogs la longs spyod dgos pa byung na/ bdag nyid lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ grib can de'i steng du ram̐ dmar po me yi rang bzhin can gcig bsams la/ sngags nyer gcig bzlas pa'i mchil ma thu thu zhes gtor bas/ ram̐ las me 'bar bas nyes skyon thams cad bsreg par bsams la longs spyod do// chu mig dang*/ rdzing bu dang*/ khron pa dang*/ chu ra sogs kyi nang du/

rdo la khro mo'i sku dang*/ rgyab tu rtsa sngags/ las sngags/ 'dod gsol dang bcas pa brkos par bskyed bstim brtan bzhugs tshul bzhin du byas na/ chu de la longs spyod pa thams cad kyi grib sel lo// nad kyi rigs gang la'ang sngags chu blud pa'am/ sngags mchil btab pa dang*/ khyad par chu 'gags la mar dang*/ gla rtsi/ ma zhu ba dang*/ sbos pa la lan tshwa brngos pa dang*/ lo brgyad dri chu/ rims la dri chu bar pa rnams la sngags brgya rtsa btab nas btang bas sel zhing*/ grib las byung ba'i shu thor dang*/ skrangs 'bur sogs la'ang sngags bzlas pa'i mchil ma bul tog dang sa tshi can la btab nas byugs pas phan no// gdon gyi rigs dang*/ smyo 'bog dang*/ grib gzer sogs la/ gu gul nag po/ shu dag nag po/ bong nga nag po/ yungs kar/ sha chen rnams la sngags nas bdug pas 'phral du zhi bar 'gyur zhing*/ yang nad gdon grib rigs spyi la/ gnas chen lta bur skyes pa'i shug pa/ bal bu/ mkhan dkar rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i dri zhim gyi sman shing sna tshogs pa lo ma rgyas pa'i dus su btus la grib skam bya/ de'i steng du sngar bshad pa ltar zla dkyil sngags phreng sogs bkod nas 'od zer spro bsdu dang bcas bzlas pa mang du byas pa'i dud pas bdug na shin tu phan zhing*/ lug nag po'i sog pa g.yas pa'i bal skud la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa skad cig gis lhar bskyed cing*/ bzlas pa'i mthar mdud pa la bstims nas mgul du btags na srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// grib rigs tshab chen la sbyong khrus dang grib sel yang yang byas pa'i mthar/ shug pa sogs sman shing sna tshogs kyi me la/ mkha' 'gro ma sme brtsegs skad cig gis bskyed/ nad pa'i skra sen sogs dang sbyar ba'i til nag po grib dang mi gtsang ba'i ngo bor mos la/ bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te rtsa sngags kyis lan brgya rtsa sogs 'bul/ mthar yi dam gyi lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa la bsgrub byas lan bdun 'gong bas grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad lhag med du tshig par bsam/

grib srung gi 'khor lo rgyas par gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ bsdu na/ shog bu la tsakra mu khyud lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐/ mu khyud dang po la rtsa sngags dang*/ gnyis par las sngags/ gsum par ā li/ bzhi par kā li/ lnga par rten 'brel snying po rnams kyi mthar/ 'chang ba po la grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ zhes sbyar ba bris pa'i phyi rol tu me ris bskor/ rab gnas spyi ltar byas la/ shel zur ma nyams pa/ bya rgod kyi sder mo/ grum pa'i spu dang bcas pa rnams bcug la tshon skud sna lngas bcing*/ dar dmar pos dril te mgul du drod dang ma bral bar bcang ngo*// de yang spyir snyigs ma'i dus 'dir grib kyi rigs tha dad pa mang po dang*/ lhag par ma mo mkha' 'gro khros pa'i grib yams thabs su 'go ba'i rims dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa'i grib kyis 'di phyi'i bde legs thams cad 'grib pa sogs kyi gnyen por grib sel gyi rigs mtha' klas pa zhig gsungs pa'i nang nas/ khro mo sme brtsegs 'di nyid gsar rnying gi gdams pa zung du 'brel zhing*/ bya sla tshigs chung phan yon che bar myong bas grub pa'i phyir/ rang gzhan kun la sman pa'i bsam pa bzang pos kun nas bslangs te/ nyer mkho'i gdam ngag zhig phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa 'di yang*/ rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa mañju gho ṣas sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun mi mthun pa'i rgud pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /khro mo sme brtsegs ma la brten pa'i grib sil man ngag bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos kun stong pa nyid du gyur// stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis// rang nyid khro rgyal sme brtsegs ma// sku mdog sol ba ltar nag pa// skyon gyis mi 'gos phyag gnyis kyis// dag byed bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs stabs su// bzhugs pa'i sku ru lam gyis gyur// oṃ khar+khaṃ dzir+khaṃ bi ma la se u tsuṣ+ma kro dhī hūm̐ phaṭa/

zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa/ shub bur bzlas brjod byas gyur na// mi gtsang grib las gyur pa yi// nyes kun dag cing sel bar 'gyur// gang 'di dpal ldan sa skya pa'i// khyad chos man ngag ji bzhin du/ bhik+ṣu blo gsal bstan skyong gis// 'khrul med yi ger bkod pa'o// dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
